_comment: Where -AllAgents installs Core (and Domain) skills, for install-skills.ps1 and anything else that syncs these skills (AI Tools Sync). A shared folder is written when any of its roots exists under the home folder. Retired folders were written before 2026-11-12; -AllAgents removes previous installs from them. Paths checked 2026-11-11 against each CLI's docs (docs/USING-SKILLS.md). ~/.codex/skills is Codex's legacy path and is never a target.
